# Dr Marco Blumendorf

> Personal website of Dr Marco Blumendorf, Director of Software Engineering at CHAPTR (Holtzbrinck Publishing Group). PhD in Distributed AI from TU Berlin. 20+ years building software, from academic research to AI-powered publishing products.

## Profile

- [Profile API (JSON)](https://blumendorf.info/api/v1/profile.json): Structured profile data including background, expertise, tech stack, and professional journey

## Sections

- [About](https://blumendorf.info/#about): Background, career journey, and working philosophy
- [Expertise](https://blumendorf.info/#expertise): Areas of focus - Developer Experience, Team Culture, Technical Leadership
- [Tech Stack](https://blumendorf.info/#tech-stack): Technologies and tools used daily
- [Journey](https://blumendorf.info/#timeline): Professional timeline from 1999 to present
- [Lab](https://blumendorf.info/lab): Experiments with browser-based LLMs, generative UI, and design system notes
- [Design System & Storybook](https://blumendorf.info/lab/storybook): Article about DESIGN.md, reusable components, Storybook, and keeping design and implementation aligned in AI-supported engineering
- [Storybook](https://blumendorf.info/storybook/): Static visual workshop linked from the design system article
- [Contact](https://blumendorf.info/#contact): Get in touch via email, LinkedIn, or GitHub

## Optional

- [Impressum](https://blumendorf.info/impressum): Legal notice (German law requirement)
